summary: Iteration 131 — Verified the second-root-cause fix for the user-reported bug: widget chat POST now includes projectId+companyId, so tutor_logs entries carry attribution and the admin dashboard's aggregation can match feedback to exported courses. All 7 backend tests pass (e2e + regressions + new-widget HTML/SCORM stamping). Frontend smoke-test on /admin → Dashboard Tutor → Didaxis shows 'Projeto SCORMIFY' row with inline 👍 3 / 👎 0 / 100% sat. badge — exactly the behavior the user expected.

Not visually broken (badges still render correctly) but indicates duplicate keys in a .map() — likely projectId collision across the 'Sem empresa' bucket where projectId can be empty. Low priority.

action_items: (optional) Fix duplicate React key warning in admin Dashboard Tutor course list — likely use `${companyId}-${projectId}` instead of just projectId as the .map() key.

Admin dashboard aggregation (admin.py L444-549) correctly groups by projectId and bulk-joins feedback in one query — no N+1.

The new pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_tutor_e2e_attribution_iter131.py is now the canonical regression for the whole 'tutor attribution → dashboard join' chain and supersedes the partially-broken iter130 file (which had a regex bug & wrong SCORM extraction location). rca_of_the_issue: Two-root-cause bug. (a) Iter 130 fixed the exporter side: routes/export.py now stamps projectId+companyId into tutorConfig dict so the embedded HTML/SCORM widget knows its own identity. (b) Iter 131 fixes the widget side: services/export_assets/tutor.js was building the /api/tutor/chat payload WITHOUT those fields, so even after iter 130 every chat from any exported course landed in tutor_logs with projectId=''. The aggregation in /api/admin/tutor-dashboard groups by projectId, so all empty-projectId rows collapsed into one synthetic bucket that could never be enriched with feedbackSummary for the real course. Adding `projectId: config.projectId || ''` and `companyId: config.companyId || ''` to the chat fetch body restores the chain: export → chat(projectId) → tutor_logs(projectId) → feedback(projectId) → dashboard joins by projectId → courses[] + companies[].courseList[] both show the entry with feedbackSummary populated. Reproduction (post-fix): see test_e2e_chat_with_projectid_persisted_and_joined_in_dashboard — POSTs a chat with attribution, asserts Mongo persistence, POSTs an up-rating feedback, fetches /api/admin/tutor-dashboard, asserts the project is in courses[] with upTotal>=1 and satisfactionPct populated, and is also present under companies[].courseList[]. Mitigation for production: redeploy + re-export courses; old in-the-wild SCORM packages continue not reporting until re-exported.
